visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair sits on a grass lawn densely covered in pink cherry blossom petals. She sits beneath a large cherry blossom tree in full bloom. She wears a beige trench coat over a dark top and denim shorts, with white sneakers. She smiles and waves one hand towards the camera, appearing relaxed and happy in the natural setting. (2) The camera slowly zooms out from a medium shot to a full shot, revealing more of the park's environment. In the background, several individuals are seated on classic green park benches positioned under lush green trees. The ground is consistently carpeted with fallen pink petals, and the lighting is bright and natural daylight, illuminating the entire scene evenly. (3) The subject maintains her seated position, shifting her poses slightly while looking towards and away from the lens. The background reveals a paved walkway where a few more people can be seen in the distance, including a white vehicle parked near the park's edge. The wind gently rustles the branches, causing more pink petals to float down from the cherry blossom tree.
